name: gpt_researcher_replica
description: Source-shaped GPT Researcher standard report: automatic research identity, seed search before query planning, parallel sub-query search/scrape workers, original-query coverage, source curation and grounded report writing.

strategist.description: Selects the dynamic role, plans from initial search results and curates sources

researcher.description: Runs bounded search/scrape loops for seed and sub-queries

writer.description: Writes the final report from curated context

plan.description: Plan sub-queries from an actual seed search result

curate.description: Rank and clean source material by relevance, credibility and reliability

json_fallback.agent_role_prompt: You are an objective, critical research assistant.

inputs.message:
${ctx.agent_role}

Run an initial public web search for this task: ${ctx.request}. Return a compact sample of relevant results with exact URLs. This material will be used to plan the research outline.

abstain.value: 没有检索到可靠来源，因此不生成看似可信但无依据的报告。
